defs.def: a type of food made from milk that can be either soft or hard and is usually white or yellow in colour; a particular type of this food 干酪；奶酪

ex.s: Butcher shops, greengrocers, bakeries, and cheese shops line the town square.
ex.t: （翻译待校对补充）

ex.s: Neighbors will bring me freshly made cheese and will come to my door to ___27___ me to close the window in my car when rain is coming.
ex.t: 邻居会给我送来新做的奶酪，快下雨时还会上门____我关上车窗。

ex.s: Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is road testing a new way to keep winter roads ice-free -by spreading on them cheese brine, the salty liquid used to make soft cheeses, like mozzarella.
ex.t: 威斯康星州密尔沃基市正在道路测试一种保持冬季道路无冰的新方法——在上面撒奶酪卤水，即制作马苏里拉奶酪等软奶酪时使用的咸味液体。

ex.s: Wisconsin, also called “America’s Dairyland,” is famous for its cheese.
ex.t: 威斯康星州也被称为"美国乳制品之乡"，以奶酪闻名。

ex.s: The state produced 2.8 billion pounds of cheese last year!
ex.t: 该州去年生产了28亿磅奶酪！

ex.s: As a result, there was a lot of leftover cheese brine.
ex.t: 结果，产生了大量剩余的奶酪卤水。

ex.s: So what should cheese makers do with the waste?
ex.t: 那么奶酪制造商应该如何处理这些废料呢？

ex.s: But using cheese brine could help both cheese producers and cities save money, while keeping roads safe Cheese brine has salt in it, which, like the rock salt, helps lower water’s freezing point.
ex.t: 但使用奶酪浴缸可以帮助奶酪生产者和城市省钱,同时保持道路安全 奶酪浴缸里还有盐,这与岩石盐一样,有助于降低水的冻结点。

ex.s: In addition to saving money, cheese brine could also be a more eco-friendly option.
ex.t: 除了省钱外,奶酪浴缸还可以是一种更有利于生态的选择.

ex.s: Cheese brine has a downside too a smell similar to that of bad milk.
ex.t: 奶酪卤水也有缺点——一种类似变质牛奶的气味。

ex.s: He works for one of Wisconsin’s county highway commissions and came up with the idea of using cheese brine.
ex.t: 他为威斯康星州的一个县公路委员会工作，并想到了用奶酪卤水铺路的主意。

ex.s: Why can cheese brine help keep winter roads ice-free?
ex.t: 为什么奶酪卤水能帮助保持冬季道路无冰？

ex.s: Saving the cheese industry.
ex.t: 拯救奶酪产业。

ex.s: It reminded me of blue cheese, a similarly strong smelling type o food you either love or hate.
ex.t: 它让我想起蓝纹奶酪，一种气味同样浓烈、让人爱憎分明的食物。

ex.s: This means we don’t eat meat, and any milk or cheese had better be dairy-free.
ex.t: 这意味着我们不吃肉，任何牛奶或奶酪最好不含乳制品。

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。
